articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5 in late July 2026, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a unified architecture that collapses previously separate models into one system. Benchmarks show substantial gains on PhD-level science questions and multi-step agentic coding tasks, though independent evaluations highlight persistent challenges with factual grounding in niche domains.

articles.title: Google DeepMind Unveils Gemini Ultra 2 with Real-Time Tool Use and Million-Token Workflows
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2 with a production-ready 2-million-token context window and deeply integrated tool-use capabilities that allow the model to autonomously chain API calls, browser actions, and code execution. Early enterprise adopters report 40% reductions in multi-step research workflows, positioning the model as a serious competitor for agentic enterprise deployments.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Assembly Lines
articles.summary: Tesla has started deploying its third-generation Optimus humanoid robot in select Gigafactory assembly stations, handling component sorting, bin picking, and light inspection tasks alongside human workers. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and a new vision-language model for interpreting verbal task instructions, though cycle times remain slower than purpose-built industrial arms.

articles.title: Figure and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Pilot to Full Vehicle Sub-Assembly Line
articles.summary: Figure AI announced the expansion of its BMW partnership from a single-station pilot to a full sub-assembly line at the Spartanburg plant, with Figure 03 robots performing wire harness routing and clip insertion. The deployment leverages a foundation model trained on thousands of hours of human demonstration data, enabling rapid re-tasking without traditional robot programming.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude's 'Artifacts OS' — A Persistent Workspace for AI-Assisted Engineering
articles.summary: Anthropic rolled out a major platform update turning Claude's artifact system into a persistent, version-controlled workspace where engineers can iteratively build applications, data pipelines, and analyses across sessions. The feature includes Git-like branching, dependency management, and collaborative sharing, signaling a shift from chat-based AI interaction toward integrated development environments powered by LLMs.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Behemoth as Open Weights, Matching Frontier Closed Models
articles.summary: Meta released the full weights of Llama 4 Behemoth, a massive mixture-of-experts model that matches or exceeds GPT-5 and Gemini Ultra 2 on key reasoning and coding benchmarks. The open-weights release has triggered a wave of fine-tuned variants within days, reigniting debate about the safety implications of open frontier models while dramatically lowering costs for enterprises seeking sovereign AI deployments.

articles.title: ASML Reports Record EUV High-NA Orders as Chip Firms Race Toward 1.4nm Process Nodes
articles.summary: ASML disclosed record quarterly bookings for its high-numerical-aperture EUV lithography systems, driven by orders from TSMC, Samsung, and Intel targeting 1.4nm-class process nodes expected in 2027-2028. The high-NA tools enable finer patterning without multi-pass exposure, a critical bottleneck for next-generation AI accelerator chips that demand ever-higher transistor densities and energy efficiency.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Electric Demonstrates Autonomous Disaster Site Navigation in DARPA Trial
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics' fully electric Atlas humanoid completed a DARPA-supervised urban disaster response trial, autonomously navigating rubble fields, opening doors, and manipulating valve shutoffs without remote operator intervention for over 90 minutes. The robot used an on-board vision-language-action model for scene understanding, representing a major milestone in closing the sim-to-real gap for unstructured environment locomotion and manipulation.
